title: Flow through a narrowed artery
caption: At the same pressure difference, Poiseuille flow goes as the fourth power of the radius. Narrowing an artery to 75% of its radius cuts the flow to 0.75⁴ = 0.32, about a third.
alt: Relative flow against relative radius, a steep fourth-power curve, with 0.32 at 0.75 marked.
description: Q ∝ r⁴ (Poiseuille), at fixed pressure difference, length and viscosity.
r = 0.5 r₀: Q = 0.0625 Q₀. Small narrowings matter a great deal.
